curriculum.subject: Mathematical Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: draw straight lines on different surfaces

mission.title: draw straight lines on different surfaces

interactions.prompt: Draw a straight line on the sand from the shell to the leaf.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the shell, then tap the leaf to make the straight line.
interactions.feedback: Great! Your line goes straight across the sand.
interactions.retryHint: Start at the shell and move straight to the leaf. Do not turn.

interactions.prompt: Watch the guide make one straight chalk line. Now draw a straight line from A to B.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap A, then tap B to make the straight chalk line.
interactions.feedback: Well done! A straight line joins A and B.
interactions.retryHint: Begin at A. Keep going in one direction until B.

interactions.prompt: Draw a straight line down the page from the sun to the flower.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the sun, then tap the flower to draw the straight line.
interactions.feedback: Yes! Your straight line goes down the paper.
interactions.retryHint: Go straight down from the sun to the flower.

interactions.prompt: Make a straight fence rail from post 1 to post 2.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap post 1, then tap post 2 to make the straight rail.
interactions.feedback: Correct! The fence rail is a straight line.
interactions.retryHint: Keep your line level as it goes from post 1 to post 2.

interactions.prompt: On the classroom floor, draw a straight tape line from the door to the mat.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the door, then tap the mat to place the straight tape line.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! The tape goes straight from the door to the mat.
interactions.retryHint: Aim straight for the mat. A straight line does not bend.

interactions.prompt: Show what you know. Draw a straight road line from the bus to the school.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap the bus, then tap the school to draw the straight road line.
interactions.feedback: You did it! You drew a straight line on a new surface.
interactions.retryHint: Start at the bus and travel straight to the school.
